attempts.cause: The add_hire procedure inserts data into employee_directory_v, which is a view, instead of the underlying table HR_CONTACTS where phone numbers are stored.
The add_hire procedure was missing the insertion of the person into hr_people, causing foreign key constraint violations when inserting into hr_contacts.
